error.hint.config: A configuration problem (API key, voice, input) — open Settings to fix it, then press Continue. Retrying on its own will not help.
error.hint.rateLimit: The provider is rate-limiting — the app will wait and carry on by itself.
error.hint.resource: A machine-level problem (missing binary, full disk, permissions) — check ffmpeg / Chrome / free space, then press Continue.
error.hint.transient: A temporary error — the app is carrying on by itself.
